title: The Golden Era Of Cheap AI Is Ending #claudecode #aitools #aiagents
description:
Claude Fable 5 just proved the cheap-AI era is closing. Investors subsidized your $20 subscription for years, but with Anthropic and OpenAI filing to go public, Fable 5 going pay-as-you-go after June 22 at double the price of Opus 4.8, and OpenAI testing ads, frontier AI is about to get expensive.

Here's how to lock in cheap AI while you still can. Get the playbook here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A_3ZtKhONWzR95dsjj9jZQBeYwwHQYnU/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true

#Shorts #AI #claude
